<description>
Since #32618, `getaddressinfo` returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. It was kept and marked "(DEPRECATED)" so it could be removed later without surprising users ([review comment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32618#discussion_r2180720302)), but it was never put behind `-deprecatedrpc`. The v30 release notes also say it was already removed from all RPCs, which isn't true for `getaddressinfo`.

This returns it only with `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly`, like `startingheight` in `getpeerinfo` (#34197), so it can be removed in the next release.
</description>

<commits>
375dc869d8 rpc: deprecate iswatchonly field of getaddressinfo

Since watch-only was removed from the wallet in #32618, iswatchonly is
always false. It was kept and marked "(DEPRECATED)" in the help so that
it could be removed later without surprising users, but it was never
put behind -deprecatedrpc, although the v30 release notes say it was
removed from all RPCs.

Return it only with -deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly, as was done for the
startingheight field of getpeerinfo, so it can be removed in the next
release.

5b2f979c9e doc: add release note for getaddressinfo iswatchonly deprecation
</commits>
